$comment: Leave (lib/leave.js): the kinds of leave a store's people take, how many days a year each gives and how many carry into the next, and how an approved day shows in attendance — paid leave as leave, unpaid as absent, so payroll pays or deducts it. A day of leave is a working day of the week; a store sets its own working days and kinds in settings leave.workingDays and leave.types. A person's own allowance for a year overrides the kind's. Whoever asked for leave, or the person it is for, does not approve it.
